mapper.select: select bd.uid as woha_uid, count(distinct relation.family_id) as guild_count, coalesce(sum(case when stat.count_day = curdate() then stat.gold_num + stat.luck_gold_num else 0 end), 0) as day_flow, coalesce(sum(case when stat.count_day >= date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day) then stat.gold_num + stat.luck_gold_num else 0 end), 0) as week_flow, coalesce(sum(case when date_format(stat.count_day, '%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m') then stat.gold_num + stat.luck_gold_num else 0 end), 0) as month_flow, coalesce(sum(stat.gold_num + stat.luck_gold_num), 0) as total_flow from bd_user bd left join bd_user_family relation on relation.bd_user_id = bd.bd_user_id left join bd_user_family_day stat on stat.bd_user_family_id = relation.id where bd.uid in #{uid} and bd.status <= 1 group by bd.uid

select count(distinct family_user.uid) from bd_user bd join bd_user_family relation on relation.bd_user_id = bd.bd_user_id join fm_family_user family_user on family_user.family_id = relation.family_id and family_user.anchor_status = 1 where bd.uid in #{uid} and bd.status <= 1
